newsitem.title: ITALY: Bulgari stock rises on perfumes deal.
newsitem.headline: Bulgari stock rises on perfumes deal.

text.p: Shares in Italian jewellery and luxury goods group Bulgari rose on the Milan stock exchange after the announcement of a global linkup with privately-owned Ferragamo in the perfumes sector.
Bulgari and Ferragamo said they would set up two new companies to develop perfumes under the brand names Ferragamo and Ungaro.
At 1138 GMT, Bulgari ordinary shares were 4.06 percent up at 30,000 lire after touching a high of 30,100 lire. The all-share Mibtel index posted a gain of 0.79 percent.
